posts.author: Bloomberg Tech
posts.text: Anthropic AI Model Went Rogue, Submitted Fake Tip to Police. Anthropic PBC said its Claude AI model carried out additional unintended actions on the digital systems of outside organizations, including submitting a false tip in a police homicide case, prompting a warning from the Trump administration for artificial intelligence companies to secure their systems.

posts.author: Simon Willison
posts.text: Quoting The New York Times. Anthropic detailed the activity of its A.I. agents in a blog post on Friday, without naming the targeted websites. But two sources with knowledge of the incidents said Anthropic’s A.I. agents had submitted 20 visa applications through a form available on the State Department’s website. All the applications were incomplete and were not processed, they said. — The New York Times , Anthropic Agents Tried to Fill Out Visa Forms on State Dept. posts.text: Google's Gemini 4 "Carbon" model is reportedly matching Anthropic's Opus 5.5 coding performance.
